svg.title: Pheme phone Results visual draft
svg.desc: Three proposed iPhone screens: overall conversation metrics and graphs, the full app-memory metric graph, and app memory during Turn 2 reply generation. All data is illustrative.

g.text: One conversation. Every metric. The detail behind it.
Overall graphs → individual metric → turn / operation
See the whole conversation at a glance.
Tap App memory to see its full history.
Narrow the graph to a single reply.
Tap a stage to inspect its operation
Whole app · 52 readings · tap for graph
CPU, battery, stage timings and more
Memory belongs to the whole app,
sampled while this reply was generated.
Totals and graphs cover all turns in the chat.
Every metric gets its own graph.
Units, readings and statistics stay together.
Keep the context as you drill down.
Same chat, same metric, one operation.
Proposed screens · illustrative values, not benchmark measurements · content scrolls on phone
